relationships.subject: ADU-S100
relationships.evidence_quote: repeated intrathecal injections of ADU-S100 significantly reversed both early and late mechanical allodynia in male mice after SNI, without apparent tolerance

relationships.subject: IFN-β
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of recombinant IFN-ß significantly reversed mechanical allodynia in male mice after SNI, but not in female mice

relationships.subject: ADU-S100
relationships.evidence_quote: the transcripts of proinflammatory cytokines IL-1β, TNFα, and CCL2 (chemokine ligand 2) showed significant increases only in female mice treated with ADU-S100

key_findings: Microglial STING agonism with ADU-S100 relieves nerve-injury allodynia in male but not female mice via TBK1 and IFN-β.
Microglial STING is not required for allodynia development.
